The engagement would cover pre-suit analysis, drafting a complaint, and initial injunction proceedings. Nova has already sent over a draft complaint, several patent files, and a proposed engagement letter. Before I can conditionally approve this under our intake policy, I need findings from conflicts, ethics, client intake, and patent litigation. Let's start working through each of those areas. What are we seeing on conflicts first?
